item.title: ‘Mr. Irrelevant’ Trailer: David Corenswet Suits Up As John Tuggle In Jonathan Levine’s Underdog Sports Drama
item.description: There is a certain kind of sports movie title that almost dares you to underestimate it, and “ Mr. Irrelevant ” certainly qualifies. But Paramount Pictures and director Jonathan Levine are aiming for something warmer and more old-school with this inspirational football drama about John Tuggle , the final pick in the 1983 NFL Draft who became a beloved New York Giant. David Corenswet , coming off “ Superman ,” stars as Tuggle, alongside Isabel May as his love interest Katie and Michael Shannon as legendary Giants coach Bill Parcells .
